_comment: Skin tone groups and the clothing colours recommended for each. Tone groups and colour lists come from the original research notebooks; ITA ranges follow the Chardon et al. ITA classification, split into seven bands.

tones.label: Very Fair
tones.description: Porcelain to ivory skin that burns easily. Saturated jewel tones and crisp primaries add contrast without washing you out.

tones.label: Fair
tones.description: Light skin with a soft glow. Earthy and deep shades balance your natural lightness.

tones.label: Olive / Medium
tones.description: Medium skin with green or golden hints. Rich wine and berry shades bring out warmth.

tones.label: Light Brown
tones.description: Tan to light brown skin. Cool blues, teals and soft greys complement golden undertones.

tones.label: Brown
tones.description: Warm brown skin. Bright yellows, greens and clean whites pop beautifully.

tones.label: Dark Brown
tones.description: Deep brown skin. High-contrast neutrals and pinks create a striking look.

tones.label: Deep
tones.description: Rich, deep skin. Almost every bold colour works; brights and pastels are especially vibrant.

common.label: Everyday Essentials
common.description: Versatile shades that suit every skin tone.
